Messages.Author: Fred Banville
Messages.Body:
"[...]. Each weapon possessed by a minion you control
inflicts +1 damage during combat.[...]"

From the "Mass Reality" card.

Does it mean that all the weapons on ONE minion inflicts more damage or
all the
weapons on ALL minions inflicts more damage. If you carefully read the
card, it can be
interpreted both ways. Which one is the right one?

Fred :)

______________
Shadows are the one who grows and shrinks, but as unclear as they seem,
they need
light to live.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Fred Banville wrote:
>
> "[...]. Each weapon possessed by a minion you control
> inflicts +1 damage during combat.[...]"
>
> From the "Mass Reality" card.
>
> Does it mean that all the weapons on ONE minion inflicts more damage or
> all the
> weapons on ALL minions inflicts more damage. If you carefully read the
> card, it can be
> interpreted both ways. Which one is the right one?

The latter.

Each weapon inflicts +1 damage if it's possesed by a minion you control.
Each weapon inflicts +1 damage if its possesor is controlled by you.
